I don willke the doubtlets, divine har-many of three great names (how jully joined) of _Wil- ton, Greece,_ and _Rome?_ His verfe, but for his little feck of mortality, in its extreme parts, as his hero had in his heel; like him, had been insulterable, and imoro-tal. But, unfortunately, _that_ was undute to Helicon; as _this_ in Stryx. Harmony as well as duquencais effen-tial to potify, and a murder of a number of us about you. We made by blank verfe is, verfe unfallen, uncurlt; verfe reclaimed, remithrored in the true _language of the girls_ who ever understood, not suffered their Homer to thunder in rhime.
